headline: Samsung Electronics Q3 Operating Profit Tops 100 Trillion Won, Reaching 107.4 Trillion Won
summary: Samsung Electronics reported preliminary third-quarter sales of 195 trillion won and operating profit of 107.4 trillion won. Sales rose 126.59% and operating profit 782.50% from a year earlier.
why: Samsung Electronics is South Korea's largest company and a major memory-chip and smartphone maker, so its results weigh heavily on KOSPI and the won.

impacts.name: Samsung Electronics
impacts.why: Preliminary quarterly results show a very large profit increase for the company.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The sharp year-on-year jump in sales and operating profit is a strong earnings signal for a company that carries large weight in Korean equity indices.
